"""Kitchen control record. All sensing and execution use the robot client."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def connect():
    return Robot()

def record(res, name):
    res.save(str(OUT / name))
    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':
    r = connect()
    spec = r.spec()
    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
    res = record(r.get_obs(video='none'), 'initial')
    print(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
s=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'))
joints=s['proprio']['joints']; axes=np.array(s['proprio']['axis']); centres=np.array(s['proprio']['position_m'])
names=s['links']['names']; parents=s['links']['parent']; ranges=np.array(s['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad']); actuators=s['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
# Joint order follows child link order except the fixed hand adapters.
children=[n for n in names[1:] if n not in ['left_hand','right_hand']]
assert len(children)==len(joints)
child_joint=dict(zip(children,range(len(joints))))
parent=dict(zip(names,parents))

def transforms(q):
 tr={'pelvis':np.eye(4)}
 for n in names[1:]:
  T=tr[parent[n]].copy()
  if n in child_joint:
   j=child_joint[n]; R=Rotation.from_rotvec(axes[j]*q[j]).as_matrix()
   H=np.eye(4); H[:3,:3]=R; H[:3,3]=centres[j]-R@centres[j]
   T=T@H
  tr[n]=T
 return tr

def point(q,link,p):
 return (transforms(q)[link]@np.r_[p,1])[:3]

def action(q):
 a=[]
 for i,n in enumerate(actuators):
  if '_A_' in n:
   jn=n.replace('_A_','_')
   if jn.endswith('J0'): v=q[joints.index(jn[:-1]+'1')]+q[joints.index(jn[:-1]+'2')]
   else:v=q[joints.index(jn)]
  else:v=q[joints.index(n)]
  a.append(2*(v-ranges[i,0])/(ranges[i,1]-ranges[i,0])-1)
 return np.clip(a,-1,1)

def ik(q,side,target,link='palm',local=None,orientation=None):
 if local is None:local=np.array([.41,.214 if side=='lh' else -.214,.087])
 lname=side+'_'+link
 arm=['left_shoulder_pitch','left_shoulder_roll','left_shoulder_yaw','left_elbow','left_wrist_yaw','lh_WRJ2','lh_WRJ1'] if side=='lh' else ['right_shoulder_pitch','right_shoulder_roll','right_shoulder_yaw','right_elbow','right_wrist_yaw','rh_WRJ2','rh_WRJ1']
 idx=[joints.index(j) for j in arm]
 lim=[ranges[actuators.index(j.replace('lh_','lh_A_').replace('rh_','rh_A_'))] for j in arm]
 def loss(x):
  v=q.copy();v[idx]=x
  tr=transforms(v)[lname];pos=(tr@np.r_[local,1])[:3]
  res=list((pos-target)*10)
  if orientation is not None: res.extend(((tr[:3,:3]-orientation)*.7).ravel())
  res.extend((x-q[idx])*.015)
  return res
 fit=least_squares(loss,np.clip(q[idx],np.array(lim)[:,0]+1e-6,np.array(lim)[:,1]-1e-6),bounds=(np.array(lim)[:,0],np.array(lim)[:,1]),max_nfev=400)
 v=q.copy();v[idx]=fit.x
 return v,point(v,lname,local),np.linalg.norm(fit.fun)

if __name__=='__main__':
 q=np.array(json.load(open('/app/output/initial/meta.json'))['proprio']['now'][:69])
 for side in ['lh','rh']:print(side,point(q,side+'_palm',[.41,.214 if side=='lh' else -.214,.087]))
 print('foot',point(q,'left_ankle_link',[-.061,.203,-1.065]))

"""Kitchen control record, using only rcb_client observations and joint servos.
Run with --replay to reproduce the recorded normalized servo sequence.
Incremental commands are appended to actions.npy before execution.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT = Path('/app/output')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def record(res, name):
    res.save(str(OUT / name))
    (OUT / 'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    np.save(OUT / 'q.npy', np.asarray(res.meta['proprio']['now'][:69]))
    return res

def execute(A, note=''):
    r = Robot()
    status = r.status()
    if status['done']:
        print(json.dumps(status)); return
    A=np.asarray(A,dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1,61)
    old=np.load(OUT/'actions.npy') if (OUT/'actions.npy').exists() else np.empty((0,61),np.float32)
    np.save(OUT/'actions.npy',np.concatenate([old,A]))
    name=f"step_{status['control_steps']+len(A):03d}"
    res=record(r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.02,interpolate='hold',video='frames',video_fps=25,note=note),name)
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in res.meta.items() if k!='proprio'},indent=2))
    print('body',np.round(res.meta['proprio']['now'][:16],3))
    print('imu',np.round(res.meta['proprio']['now'][-6:],4))
    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--replay',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--actions');parser.add_argument('--note',default='');args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.actions:execute(np.load(args.actions),args.note)
    elif args.replay:
        r=Robot();A=np.load(OUT/'actions.npy')
        for start in range(0,len(A),10):
            res=r.submit('joint_position',A[start:start+10],dt=.02,interpolate='hold',video='none')
            if res.done:break
        print(json.dumps(r.status()))
    else:
        r=Robot();print(json.dumps(r.status()))
        record(r.get_obs(video='none'),'current')
